segments.text: AI agents now sign payments, approvals and permits on their own. One bad signature can empty a wallet.
presign-guard checks it first. Send what your agent is about to sign, and get back green, orange or red, with the reasons.
An unlimited token approval? Orange: ask a person before you sign.
A permit that hands a plain wallet your tokens? Red. That is how most wallet drainers work.
And a normal x402 payment? Green. It moves one fixed amount, once.
Agents pay one cent per check with x402, in USDC on Base, and get the verdict in the same request.
Errors are never charged. And if a data source is down, there is no verdict, never a guessed green.
